title: What Happens If You Swallow Gum?
speaker: SciShow Kids
zh: 【SciShow Kids】如果吞下口香糖會怎樣？（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: I was just telling Squeaks about a mistake I made today.
cues.en: I was just telling Squeaks about a mistake I made today.
cues.zh: 我只是告訴吱吱我今天犯了一個錯誤。

cues.text: Everyone makes mistakes sometimes, and that’s OK.
cues.en: Everyone makes mistakes sometimes, and that’s OK.
cues.zh: 每個人有時都會犯錯，沒關係。

cues.text: But I always try to learn from my mistakes so I can do better next time, and today I
cues.en: But I always try to learn from my mistakes so I can do better next time, and today I
cues.zh: 但我總是努力從錯誤中學到教訓，這樣下次我就能做得更好，今天我

cues.text: learned something that surprised me!
cues.en: learned something that surprised me!
cues.zh: 學到了令我驚訝的東西！

cues.text: Let me explain what happened.
cues.en: Let me explain what happened.
cues.zh: 讓我解釋一下發生了什麼事。

cues.text: I was chewing some gum right before lunch.
cues.en: I was chewing some gum right before lunch.
cues.zh: 午餐前我正在嚼口香糖。

cues.text: I was eating with one of my friends, and when we sat down at the table, I got distracted
cues.en: I was eating with one of my friends, and when we sat down at the table, I got distracted
cues.zh: 我和一位朋友一起吃飯，當我們坐在餐桌旁時，我心煩意亂

cues.text: talking to her and swallowed my gum just like a piece of regular food!
cues.en: talking to her and swallowed my gum just like a piece of regular food!
cues.zh: 和她說話，然後像吃普通食物一樣吞下了我的口香糖！

cues.text: I know — I was worried too at first, because you’re never supposed to swallow gum.
cues.en: I know — I was worried too at first, because you’re never supposed to swallow gum.
cues.zh: 我知道——一開始我也很擔心，因為你永遠不應該吞下口香糖。

cues.text: I’ve heard lots of people say that the reason you’re not supposed to swallow it is because
cues.en: I’ve heard lots of people say that the reason you’re not supposed to swallow it is because
cues.zh: 我聽很多人說你不應該吞下它的原因是

cues.text: gum will stay in your stomach for seven years.
cues.en: gum will stay in your stomach for seven years.
cues.zh: 口香糖會在你的胃裡停留七年。

cues.text: But after I swallowed my gum, I learned more about what happens to it inside our bodies,
cues.en: But after I swallowed my gum, I learned more about what happens to it inside our bodies,
cues.zh: 但當我吞下口香糖後，我更瞭解了它在我們體內發生的情況，

cues.text: and it turns out that’s not true!
cues.en: and it turns out that’s not true!
cues.zh: 事實證明這不是真的！

cues.text: You still should never swallow gum on purpose, or chew it at all unless a grown-up says it’s
cues.en: You still should never swallow gum on purpose, or chew it at all unless a grown-up says it’s
cues.zh: 你仍然不應該故意吞下口香糖，或完全咀嚼口香糖，除非大人說這是

cues.text: OK.
cues.en: OK.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.text: But it doesn’t stay in your stomach for seven years.
cues.en: But it doesn’t stay in your stomach for seven years.
cues.zh: 但它不會在你的胃裡停留七年。

cues.text: It comes right out of your body after a few days at most, just like anything else.
cues.en: It comes right out of your body after a few days at most, just like anything else.
cues.zh: 它最多幾天後就會從你的身體中排出，就像其他任何東西一樣。

cues.text: So even though I swallowed my gum by accident, I’ll be fine.
cues.en: So even though I swallowed my gum by accident, I’ll be fine.
cues.zh: 所以即使我不小心吞下了口香糖，我也會沒事的。

cues.text: The main reason you might think gum stays in your stomach if you swallow it is that
cues.en: The main reason you might think gum stays in your stomach if you swallow it is that
cues.zh: 您可能認為吞下口香糖後會留在胃裡的主要原因是

cues.text: gum isn’t regular food.
cues.en: gum isn’t regular food.
cues.zh: 口香糖不是普通食物。

cues.text: It’s made of rubber — the same type of stuff that rubber bands are made of — mixed
cues.en: It’s made of rubber — the same type of stuff that rubber bands are made of — mixed
cues.zh: 它由橡膠製成——與橡皮筋的材質相同——混合而成

cues.text: with a little sugar or sweetener.
cues.en: with a little sugar or sweetener.
cues.zh: 加一點糖或甜味劑。

cues.text: The rubber is what makes gum chewy, which is why we can keep it in our mouths for a
cues.en: The rubber is what makes gum chewy, which is why we can keep it in our mouths for a
cues.zh: 橡膠使口香糖變得有嚼勁，這就是為什麼我們可以把它放在嘴裡一段時間

cues.text: long time.
cues.en: long time.
cues.zh: 很長一段時間。

cues.text: But rubber bands aren’t food, and neither is gum!
cues.en: But rubber bands aren’t food, and neither is gum!
cues.zh: 但橡皮筋不是食物，口香糖也不是！

cues.text: It’s made so we can chew on it, but we’re not supposed to swallow it.
cues.en: It’s made so we can chew on it, but we’re not supposed to swallow it.
cues.zh: 它的設計是為了讓我們可以咀嚼它，但我們不應該吞下它。

cues.text: Your body can’t digest the rubber in gum in other words, it can’t break the gum
cues.en: Your body can’t digest the rubber in gum in other words, it can’t break the gum
cues.zh: 你的身體無法消化口香糖中的橡膠，換句話說，它無法破壞口香糖

cues.text: down into smaller pieces for energy.
cues.en: down into smaller pieces for energy.
cues.zh: 分解成更小的碎片以獲取能量。

cues.text: So even if someone swallows it, the gum stays as one big blob.
cues.en: So even if someone swallows it, the gum stays as one big blob.
cues.zh: 因此，即使有人吞下口香糖，口香糖仍然會形成一大團。

cues.text: That’s why some people might think it stays in your stomach for a really long time.
cues.en: That’s why some people might think it stays in your stomach for a really long time.
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼有些人可能認為它會在你的胃裡停留很長時間。

cues.text: But that’s not true.
cues.en: But that’s not true.
cues.zh: 但事實並非如此。

cues.text: Even though the gum stays in a blob, it moves through your body until it comes out as poop, just like everything else you
cues.en: Even though the gum stays in a blob, it moves through your body until it comes out as poop, just like everything else you
cues.zh: 即使口香糖停留在一個斑點中，它也會在您的身體中移動，直到以糞便的形式排出，就像您體內的其他東西一樣。

cues.text: eat.
cues.en: eat.
cues.zh: 吃。

cues.text: Here’s what really happens when someone chews gum and then swallows it.
cues.en: Here’s what really happens when someone chews gum and then swallows it.
cues.zh: 這是當某人咀嚼口香糖然後吞下時真正發生的情況。

cues.text: The gum is usually kind of hard when you unwrap it, but once it goes in your mouth
cues.en: The gum is usually kind of hard when you unwrap it, but once it goes in your mouth
cues.zh: 當你開啟它時，口香糖通常會有點硬，但是一旦它進入你的嘴裡

cues.text: and you start chewing it, it becomes softer.
cues.en: and you start chewing it, it becomes softer.
cues.zh: 當你開始咀嚼它時，它會變得更軟。

cues.text: If there’s sugar in the gum, your saliva will start to suck it out, which is why gum
cues.en: If there’s sugar in the gum, your saliva will start to suck it out, which is why gum
cues.zh: 如果口香糖裡有糖，你的唾液就會開始把它吸出來，這就是口香糖的原因

cues.text: usually tastes sweet for the first few minutes you chew it.
cues.en: usually tastes sweet for the first few minutes you chew it.
cues.zh: 通常在咀嚼的最初幾分鐘內會感到甜味。

cues.text: Your body actually can use the sugar for energy.
cues.en: Your body actually can use the sugar for energy.
cues.zh: 您的身體實際上可以利用糖來獲取能量。

cues.text: But not the rest of the gum, because it’s just rubber.
cues.en: But not the rest of the gum, because it’s just rubber.
cues.zh: 但口香糖的其餘部分則不然，因為它只是橡膠。

cues.text: Normally, when we’re done chewing gum we’re supposed to put it in the garbage.
cues.en: Normally, when we’re done chewing gum we’re supposed to put it in the garbage.
cues.zh: 通常，當我們嚼完口香糖後，我們應該把它丟進垃圾桶。

cues.text: But let’s say someone swallows it by accident, like I did.
cues.en: But let’s say someone swallows it by accident, like I did.
cues.zh: 但假設有人像我一樣不小心吞下了它。

cues.text: As they swallow the gum, it moves down their throat and into their stomach.
cues.en: As they swallow the gum, it moves down their throat and into their stomach.
cues.zh: 當他們吞下口香糖時，口香糖會沿著喉嚨進入胃中。

cues.text: There, it mixes with all the other stuff in their stomach and gets mushed around.
cues.en: There, it mixes with all the other stuff in their stomach and gets mushed around.
cues.zh: 在那裡，它與胃裡的所有其他東西混合並被弄成糊狀。

cues.text: But while the other stuff starts to be broken down into smaller pieces their body
cues.en: But while the other stuff starts to be broken down into smaller pieces their body
cues.zh: 但是，當其他物質開始分解成更小的碎片時，它們的身體

cues.text: can use for energy and nutrients, the gum just stays the same.
cues.en: can use for energy and nutrients, the gum just stays the same.
cues.zh: 可用作能量和營養，口香糖保持不變。

cues.text: Next, the gum moves from their stomach into the small intestine, a long, curled up tube
cues.en: Next, the gum moves from their stomach into the small intestine, a long, curled up tube
cues.zh: 接下來，口香糖從胃進入小腸，這是一條長而捲曲的管子

cues.text: that winds its way through your body.
cues.en: that winds its way through your body.
cues.zh: 它蜿蜒穿過你的身體。

cues.text: The small intestine does even more digesting, and sucks out a lot of the water from your
cues.en: The small intestine does even more digesting, and sucks out a lot of the water from your
cues.zh: 小腸的消化能力更強，會從你的身體中吸出大量的水分。

cues.text: food.
cues.en: food.
cues.zh: 食物。

cues.text: But again, the gum just moves along without changing much.
cues.en: But again, the gum just moves along without changing much.
cues.zh: 但同樣，口香糖只是移動，沒有太大變化。

cues.text: This is where swallowing gum actually /can/ be dangerous.
cues.en: This is where swallowing gum actually /can/ be dangerous.
cues.zh: 這就是吞嚥口香糖實際上/可能/危險的地方。

cues.text: It doesn’t happen a lot, but since a kid’s small intestines are … well … smaller,
cues.en: It doesn’t happen a lot, but since a kid’s small intestines are … well … smaller,
cues.zh: 這種情況不會經常發生，但由於孩子的小腸……呃……較小，

cues.text: a few people have had the gum they swallowed get stuck in the tubes.
cues.en: a few people have had the gum they swallowed get stuck in the tubes.
cues.zh: 有些人吞下的口香糖卡在管子裡。

cues.text: Then they have to go to the doctor to get things moving again.
cues.en: Then they have to go to the doctor to get things moving again.
cues.zh: 然後他們必須去看醫生才能恢復正常。

cues.text: I’m a grown up, though, so I’m not worried about that.
cues.en: I’m a grown up, though, so I’m not worried about that.
cues.zh: 不過我已經是成年人了，所以我不擔心這個。

cues.text: After it gets through the small intestine, the next stop is the large intestine.
cues.en: After it gets through the small intestine, the next stop is the large intestine.
cues.zh: 透過小腸後，下一站是大腸。

cues.text: It’s also a tube, but it’s shorter and much wider than the small intestine.
cues.en: It’s also a tube, but it’s shorter and much wider than the small intestine.
cues.zh: 它也是一根管子，但比小腸更短、更寬。

cues.text: By now, the food is almost done being digested, but I bet you can guess what happens to the
cues.en: By now, the food is almost done being digested, but I bet you can guess what happens to the
cues.zh: 現在，食物幾乎已經被消化了，但我打賭你能猜到會發生什麼

cues.text: gum.
cues.en: gum.
cues.zh: 口香糖。

cues.text: That’s right — nothing!
cues.en: That’s right — nothing!
cues.zh: 沒錯──什麼都沒有！

cues.text: The large intestine takes in some more water, and whatever’s left of the food,
cues.en: The large intestine takes in some more water, and whatever’s left of the food,
cues.zh: 大腸吸收更多的水以及食物中剩下的東西，

cues.text: and the gum, becomes poop!
cues.en: and the gum, becomes poop!
cues.zh: 口香糖就變成糞便了！

cues.text: And I think you probably know where it goes after that.
cues.en: And I think you probably know where it goes after that.
cues.zh: 我想你可能知道之後它會去哪裡。

cues.text: In all, it shouldn’t take more than a few days for gum to make it all the way through
cues.en: In all, it shouldn’t take more than a few days for gum to make it all the way through
cues.zh: 總而言之，口香糖完全透過的時間不會超過幾天

cues.text: someone’s body.
cues.en: someone’s body.
cues.zh: 某人的身體。

cues.text: Definitely not seven years!
cues.en: Definitely not seven years!
cues.zh: 絕對不是七年！

cues.text: So, now I know what really happens when someone swallows gum.
cues.en: So, now I know what really happens when someone swallows gum.
cues.zh: 所以，現在我知道當有人吞下口香糖時到底會發生什麼事。

cues.text: But I’ve learned my lesson: no more chewing gum right before lunch!
cues.en: But I’ve learned my lesson: no more chewing gum right before lunch!
cues.zh: 但我已經吸取了教訓：午餐前不要再嚼口香糖了！

cues.text: Thanks to one of our viewers, Diana, for asking us about this!
cues.en: Thanks to one of our viewers, Diana, for asking us about this!
cues.zh: 感謝我們的一位觀眾戴安娜詢問我們這個問題！

cues.text: If you want to keep learning and having fun with Squeaks and me, hit the subscribe button, and don’t forget to check us out on the YouTube Kids app.
cues.en: If you want to keep learning and having fun with Squeaks and me, hit the subscribe button, and don’t forget to check us out on the YouTube Kids app.
cues.zh: 如果您想繼續學習並與 Squeaks 和我一起享受樂趣，請點選訂閱按鈕，並且不要忘記在 YouTube Kids 應用上檢視我們。

cues.text: We’ll see you next time, here at the Fort!
cues.en: We’ll see you next time, here at the Fort!
cues.zh: 我們下次在堡壘見！
